2608.14211.title: Training Fair Tabular Foundation Models
2608.14211.paper_summary: Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) have emerged as leading methods for tabular predictive tasks, leveraging in-context learning to predict on new data without task-specific training. Despite the increased use of TFMs in high-stakes decision-making, their fairness properties remain largely unexplored. In this work, we incorporate fairness constraints directly into TFM training, enabling fair predictions in a single forward pass. Our approach addresses two key challenges: limited access to sensitive attributes in training data, and the incompatibility of existing fairness techniques with the in-context learning paradigm. We propose FairTFM, a scalable training strategy based on synthetic fairness tasks and a fairness-aware architecture using a gradient reversal layer, which encourages the model to learn representations invariant to sensitive attributes. Experiments on 132 fairness tasks show consistent improvements in fairness while maintaining competitive accuracy.
2608.14211.paper_summary_zh: 表格基礎模型（TFMs）已成為表格預測任務的主要方法，利用上下文學習在沒有特定任務訓練的情況下對新數據進行預測。儘管TFMs在高風險決策中的使用日益增加，但它們的公平性特徵仍然在很大程度上未被探索。在本研究中，我們將公平性約束直接納入TFM訓練，使得在單次前向傳遞中能夠進行公平預測。我們的方法解決了兩個關鍵挑戰：訓練數據中對敏感屬性的有限訪問，以及現有公平性技術與上下文學習範式的不兼容性。我們提出了FairTFM，一種基於合成公平性任務和使用梯度反轉層的公平性感知架構的可擴展訓練策略，該策略鼓勵模型學習對敏感屬性不變的表示。在132個公平性任務上的實驗顯示，在保持競爭性準確性的同時，公平性有了一致的改善。
